scenes.title: Rai and the unfinished war
scenes.rationale: The rest, historical account, and recovery plan share Rai's sanctuary and the same immediate goal.

scenes.title: Approaching the Impossible Tower
scenes.rationale: Crossing the ash, examining the tower, and attempting entry form the approach; the redirected arrivals begin a new situation.

scenes.title: Scattered at the gate
scenes.rationale: The separated party's simultaneous bluff and fight converge into one entrance encounter, ending when the foyer is secure.

scenes.title: The floor of frozen lightning
scenes.rationale: The party changes orientation and bypasses a distinct guardian before reaching the library.

scenes.title: The last stand of Seeker 6
scenes.rationale: One uninterrupted library battle unites the party with its stranded simulacrum and ends with both defenders dead.

scenes.title: The library's secrets
scenes.rationale: Recovery, the library discoveries, and the ascent all establish the route to the queen.

scenes.title: Beyond the queen's illusion
scenes.rationale: Scouting reveals the queen's chamber and defenders, followed by preparations at the hatch; the first attack starts the next scene.

scenes.title: The Queen of Ash
scenes.rationale: The sustained battle begins with Sickening Radiance and ends with the last defenders' destruction, when combat gives way to escape.

scenes.title: The relic beyond the ruins
scenes.rationale: The collapsing tower forces an escape into the treasure sphere and a race back to Rai with the relic.

scenes.title: Let the world move on
scenes.rationale: The planar ritual, Rai's farewell, and evacuation resolve the adventure.
